RetinueReviewed October 9, 2026

A focused map of agents that act.

Retinue is a hand-curated directory of standalone AI agents: products built around an agent experience, not an agent feature tucked inside a broader app.

What qualifies

A listing must be a standalone product that people can use directly. Models, frameworks, infrastructure and agent features bolted onto unrelated products do not qualify.

Three categories

Personal agents handle everyday work, browser agents act across the web, and code agents work inside software projects.

The curation bar

Every agent must be a standalone product, have real users and show active maintenance. Listings are researched and curated by hand rather than pulled from an automated feed.
